```{r}
## Load the final probabilities
fate_df = read_csv("/wynton/group/paredes/Aunoy/f5_final_probs.csv")
```

```{r}
fate_df
```

```{r}
ixs = match(fate_df$barcode, colnames(cds))
fate_df$initial = colData(cds)$class[ixs]
```

```{r}
#library(ggpubr)
fate_df %>% pivot_longer(!c(barcode, initial), names_to = "fate", values_to = "prob") %>%
  filter(!is.na(initial)) %>%
  ggviolin(x = "fate", y = "prob", width = 1, fill = "initial", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.01, width = 0.03, alpha = 0.1, trim = TRUE, quantiles = TRUE) + facet_wrap(~initial) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3c54cf", "#c43f69")) + 
  RotatedAxis() + ylim(0.1, 1) + NoLegend() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1/2) + coord_flip()
```
